Sacramento, CA

The Department of Health Care Access and Information (HCAI) seeks an Enterprise Web Services Engineer to develop, maintain, and support its public-facing WordPress websites and related web applications. The role also supports web deployment, application performance, security, accessibility, and the Azure infrastructure behind HCAI’s web platforms.
Healthcare
Dental
Health Care
Medical
Mental Health
No H1B
Responsibilities
The incumbent designs, develops, maintains, and supports HCAI’s public-facing WordPress websites and related web applications supporting departmental programs, including BH Connect and Health Workforce
The incumbent performs front-end and back-end web development, maintains web deployment processes, and monitors and troubleshoots application performance, security, and accessibility
The incumbent coordinates with Infrastructure and Operations staff to configure and maintain Microsoft Azure resources, web servers, and application gateways supporting HCAI’s web platforms

Preferred
Experience with web development
Experience with a Content Management System (CMS) like WordPress
Experience with JavaScript, PHP, and/or CSS/HTML
Experience working on an IT help desk triaging and resolving support tickets
Experience with the Software Development Life Cycle or other software development best practices
Benefits
HCAI supports a hybrid telework schedule for many positions, consistent with operational requirements; telework schedules are only available for CA residents.
FREE PARKING
Fully equipped pay-per-charge electric vehicle charging stations
